examples.text: Sonntags gehen die Damen manchmal zur Messe, um gute Musik zu hören, einen bekannten Organisten; keine von ihnen ist wirklich gläubig, aber die Gläubigkeit der anderen wird ihnen zum Anlaß musikalischer Ekstase; sie glauben an Gott so lange, wie die Toccata erklingt.
examples.translation: Le dimanche, ces dames vont parfois à la messe, pour entendre de bonne musique, un organiste en renom; ni l'une ni l’autre ne pratiquent mais la foi des autres les dispose à l’extase musicale; elles croient en Dieu le temps de goûter une toccata.

glosses: Pleasing to the ear; sounding agreeably; having the qualities of music; melodious; harmonious.

examples.text: She had a musical voice.

glosses: Fond of music; discriminating with regard to music; gifted or skilled in music.

examples.text: having a musical ear

glosses: Pertaining to a class of games in which players move while music plays, but have to take a fixed position when it stops; by extension, any situation where people repeatedly change positions.

examples.text: Musical beds is the faculty sport around here.

glosses: A stage performance, show or film that involves singing, dancing and musical numbers performed by the cast as well as acting.

glosses: A meeting or a party for a musical entertainment; a musicale.
